user.title: Connect your Smart Door Devices Hub
user.description: Enter a registration/join code from your app (B&D, ATA, Dominator, Garador - wherever it shows the "add remote access" screen for a new device) and your account password for that app. These register this Home Assistant instance as its own independent client, separate from the account you use in the app itself. Your account password is stored so this integration can periodically re-authenticate on its own.

error.cannot_connect: Could not set up the hub - check the join code and password and try again. See the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: Smart Door Devices Hub polling schedule
init.description: How often to check the door/light status. A different, usually less frequent, interval can apply overnight.
